text:
Monica: Hey team — we’re launching the docs localization pipeline today. EN docs will be published to /en, and we’re opening translations for fr, de, ja. See the minimal contributor flow below and the new CI checks. TL;DR: translations auto-sync via i18n-bot, translators submit PRs to docs-i18n branch, Docs reviewers approve, then we ship. Links: https://go/redwood-docs-i18n

Paul: awesome. what's the baseline coverage target?

Monica: initial goal 60% public pages in Q2, then 90% by end of year. Priority: API reference, quickstarts, SDK code samples.

Elaine: do SDK snippets get translated or kept in original code? worried about localized code comments.

Monica: code samples remain language-original. We’ll add localized surrounding prose only. We'll also add a small banner in each translated page: “Code samples are unchanged from upstream.”

Sam: i18n-bot will create PRs for each locale and attach translation memory (TM) suggestions + glossary. Example frontmatter for a translatable page:
```yaml
i18n:
  translatable: true
  locales:
    - fr
    - de
    - ja
  glossary: /docs/i18n/glossary.yml
```

Paul: what's the review process? can non-tech PMs approve?

Monica: Reviewers must be in docs-approvers list. Non-tech contributors can review copy-only changes but code-block changes require an engineer approval.

i18n-bot: PR created: docs-i18n/1977890123-add-fr-for-quickstart (checks: i18n-lint ✅, link-check ❌ — broken internal link flagged)

Matt: link-check failing due to /sdk/js/old-sample path — we need to sync snippets to new SDK v4 endpoints.

Sam: plan: we’ll run snippet-sync job against latest stable SDK tags. If sync modifies code blocks, it will add "needs-engineer-review" label.

devops-bot: i18n pipeline deployed to staging, nightly sync scheduled at 02:00 UTC.

Elaine: small ask — add a legal notice about privacy-sensitive examples (SSNs, PII) to the translation checklist.

Monica: done — added to contributors.md and CI will fail if PII detected by regex.

Paul: great, when do we announce externally?

Monica: next Wed at 10am PT in product-channel + blog post. Draft to be posted to #marketing tomorrow for review.

Sam: migrating existing translated pages from the old repo will be a manual step — I’ll open a migration plan doc and link it here when ready.

Monica: thanks everyone :tada: please ping me if you need early access to the translation dashboard.
